w: In the evening assembly, volunteers of the Children's Wing presented a program 'Thaiye Yogi Jeva'. The program presentation symbolically showed how the moon and sun narrated the efforts of Pramukh Swami Maharaj in inspiring and pleasing the devotees regardless of physical discomforts, his devotion to God and his saintliness. The one-hour presentation included a traditional dance and prayers by the volunteers.

Morning & Evening Programs During the evening cultural assembly, all those present realised the greatness of Shastriji Maharaj through a variety of presentations that described his accomplishments despite the obstacles he faced to spread the Akshar Purushottam upasana. Swamishri concluded the assembly with blessings, during which he narrated several incidents from Shastriji Maharaj's life, such as, the murti-pratishtha of Akshar Purushottam Maharaj in Vadhwan, and the construction of five spectacular mandirs. He also emphasised the importance of the Akshar Purushottam upasana.
